release_notes.en_US: Adds a signed release-notes window with background download progress, supports the four-part 1.2.0.1 test revision, and publishes the signed channel through GitHub and Gitee. The single EXE falls back to GitHub because Gitee Community release assets are limited to 100 MB.
release_notes.zh_CN: 新增签名更新日志窗口，后台下载时显示版本说明、镜像来源和进度；支持 1.2.0.1 四段测试修订号；接入 GitHub/Gitee 双镜像清单。受 Gitee 社区版 100 MB 附件限制，本次单 EXE 自动回退到 GitHub 下载。
